name: browser-use
description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.
one_liner: A tool that lets an AI 'use' a website the way a person would — clicking, typing, filling forms — so you can describe a task in plain English and have it done on any website automatically.
buyer: An operations manager who has a repetitive web task done manually today (filling out supplier portals, applying to job listings, extracting data from a dashboard with no API) and wants it automated without hiring a developer to write brittle scrapers.
business_use_cases: A recruiting agency automates applying to job boards on behalf of candidates with tailored resumes and cover letters at scale.
A back-office team automates pulling weekly reports out of vendor dashboards that have no API, saving hours of manual copy-paste.
An e-commerce seller automates cross-listing product data across multiple marketplace admin panels that don't offer bulk APIs.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche 'browser automation as a service' for one specific painful workflow (e.g. supplier portal data entry) and charge per task completed.
Offer a monthly subscription tool for small businesses that need 3-5 recurring web tasks automated (form-filling, report pulling) without technical setup.

steal_this: Pick one painfully manual, repetitive web task a local business does weekly (like re-entering data between two systems with no API) and ship a $99/month automation for just that one workflow this weekend.
